exclusively.en: The room is used exclusively for music practice after school.
exclusively.zh: 這個房間放學後專門用來進行音樂練習。

expel.en: The school may expel a student only under serious circumstances.
expel.zh: 學校只有在嚴重情況下才可能開除學生。

expend.en: The team chose to expend more effort on testing the prototype.
expend.zh: 團隊決定投入更多心力測試原型。

experimentation.en: Careful experimentation helped the class compare several possible explanations.
experimentation.zh: 仔細的實驗讓班上能比較數種可能的解釋。

extravagance.en: The essay criticizes extravagance during a period of economic difficulty.
extravagance.zh: 這篇文章批評經濟困難時期的奢侈作風。

eyewitness.en: An eyewitness gave a brief account of what happened at the station.
eyewitness.zh: 一位目擊者簡短描述了車站發生的事情。

faraway.en: The novel begins in a faraway village surrounded by mountains.
faraway.zh: 小說從一座被群山環繞的遙遠村莊開始。

february.en: The science fair will take place in february next year.
february.zh: 科展將在明年二月舉行。

fifteen.en: Fifteen students joined the reading club this semester.
fifteen.zh: 這學期有十五位學生加入閱讀社。

fifth.en: The library is located on the fifth floor of the building.

fifty.en: About fifty people attended the evening lecture.
fifty.zh: 大約有五十人參加晚間講座。

five.en: Five groups presented their projects before lunch.
five.zh: 午餐前共有五組發表專題。

forehead.en: A drop of rain landed on his forehead during the walk.
forehead.zh: 散步時，一滴雨落在他的額頭上。

forgetful.en: He became forgetful when he tried to manage too many tasks.
forgetful.zh: 當他同時處理太多事情時，就變得容易忘東忘西。

forty.en: The bus ride usually takes about forty minutes.
forty.zh: 這趟公車通常大約需要四十分鐘。

four.en: Four students volunteered to clean the classroom after the event.
four.zh: 活動後有四位學生自願留下來打掃教室。

fourteen.en: Fourteen books were added to the class reading list.
fourteen.zh: 班級閱讀清單新增了十四本書。

friday.en: The final report is due this friday before noon.
friday.zh: 期末報告要在本週五中午前繳交。

humbly.en: She humbly accepted the award and thanked her teammates.
humbly.zh: 她謙虛地接受獎項並感謝隊友。

humiliation.en: The teacher emphasized that correction should never become public humiliation.
humiliation.zh: 老師強調糾正不應變成公開羞辱。

humorously.en: The speaker humorously described a mistake from his first presentation.
humorously.zh: 講者幽默地描述自己第一次簡報時犯的錯。

hurl.en: Strong winds can hurl loose leaves across the schoolyard.
hurl.zh: 強風可能把鬆散的落葉吹過校園。

hurrah.en: The crowd shouted hurrah when the winning team returned.
hurrah.zh: 獲勝隊伍回來時，人群高喊歡呼。

hymn.en: The music class studied the structure of a traditional hymn.
hymn.zh: 音樂課研究了一首傳統聖歌的結構。

hyphen.en: Use a hyphen when the style guide requires one.
hyphen.zh: 當格式指南要求時，請使用連字號。

hypocrisy.en: The novel criticizes hypocrisy among several powerful characters.
hypocrisy.zh: 小說批評數位有權勢角色的虛偽。

gaiety.en: The festival brought music, laughter, and gaiety to the town square.
gaiety.zh: 節慶為城鎮廣場帶來音樂、笑聲與歡樂氣氛。

generalize.en: We should not generalize from a single unusual example.
generalize.zh: 我們不應從單一特殊例子做出概括。

glassware.en: The laboratory stores clean glassware in a labeled cabinet.
glassware.zh: 實驗室把乾淨的玻璃器皿存放在有標示的櫃子裡。

goldfish.en: A goldfish swam slowly around the small classroom aquarium.
goldfish.zh: 一尾金魚緩慢游過教室的小水族箱。

goodness.en: The story celebrates kindness and goodness in ordinary people.
goodness.zh: 故事讚頌平凡人身上的善意與美好。

grandchild.en: The grandchild listened carefully to an old family story.
grandchild.zh: 孫輩仔細聆聽一段古老的家族故事。

granddaughter.en: Her granddaughter helped organize the photographs in the album.
granddaughter.zh: 她的孫女協助整理相簿裡的照片。

grandson.en: His grandson visited every weekend during the summer.
grandson.zh: 他的孫子在夏天每個週末都來探望。

grate.en: Please grate the cheese before adding it to the pasta.
grate.zh: 把起司加入義大利麵前請先刨成絲。

gravestone.en: The old gravestone carried a date that was difficult to read.
gravestone.zh: 那塊老墓碑上刻著一個難以辨識的日期。

graveyard.en: The history tour passed a small graveyard beside the church.
graveyard.zh: 歷史導覽經過教堂旁的一座小墓園。

greatness.en: The biography questions how people define greatness in public life.
greatness.zh: 這本傳記探討人們如何定義公共生活中的偉大。

grove.en: Students rested in a shaded grove during the field trip.
grove.zh: 校外教學時，學生在一片有樹蔭的小樹林休息。

handbook.en: The student handbook explains the school's main rules and procedures.
handbook.zh: 學生手冊說明學校的主要規定與流程。

happening.en: Something unusual was happening near the entrance after lunch.
happening.zh: 午餐後入口附近似乎有不尋常的事情正在發生。

happiness.en: The survey asked students what contributes most to their happiness.
happiness.zh: 調查詢問學生哪些因素最能帶來幸福感。

hardy.en: These hardy plants can survive cold winters with little care.
hardy.zh: 這些耐寒植物在少量照顧下也能度過寒冬。

hare.en: A hare crossed the open field early in the morning.
hare.zh: 清晨時，一隻野兔跑過空曠田野。

harshly.en: The coach avoided speaking harshly after the team made mistakes.
harshly.zh: 球隊犯錯後，教練避免用嚴厲語氣說話。

hastily.en: She hastily packed her notes before leaving the classroom.
hastily.zh: 離開教室前，她匆忙收好筆記。

heading.en: Add a clear heading above each section of the report.
heading.zh: 請在報告每個段落上方加上清楚標題。

heavyweight.en: The article describes the company as a heavyweight in the industry.
heavyweight.zh: 文章把這家公司形容為業界重量級企業。

hearsay.en: The editor rejected hearsay and asked for verifiable evidence.
hearsay.zh: 編輯拒絕採用傳聞，並要求可查證的證據。

heavier.en: This box is heavier than the one beside it.
heavier.zh: 這個箱子比旁邊那個更重。
